goal: Summarize the top 3 security developments this week and tell me which actively exploited CVEs I should patch first

plan.understanding: The analyst wants a summary of the top 3 security developments for the week of November 19, 2026, and a prioritized list of actively exploited CVEs to patch first.
assumptions: This week refers to the 7 days preceding November 19, 2026.
Actively exploited CVEs can be identified via CISA KEV recent additions and current threat news.
plan.done_when: The summary contains the top 3 security developments of the week and a prioritized list of recently added actively exploited CVEs for patching.

args.query: top cybersecurity news vulnerabilities exploit November 2026

steps.why: Finds major security developments and news items from the past week.
Retrieves CVEs added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog in the last 7 days.
Check metrics for LiteLLM CVE added to KEV on 2026-11-18
Check metrics for Puppet Enterprise CVE added to KEV on 2026-11-17
Check metrics for Apache Axis CVE added to KEV on 2026-11-18

result.summary: This week's security developments include the disclosure of the OpenJDK 'Java4Shell' vulnerability (CVE-2026-114938), new AI security initiatives such as Microsoft Perception joining industry pushes, and federal warnings regarding actively exploited computer and smartphone flaws. Additionally, CISA added several new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

findings.text: CVE-2026-114938 (aka 'Java4Shell') in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder allows attackers to run code on servers hosting widely used Java apps, as reported by Help Net Security (https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/18/java4shell-openjdk-vulnerability-cve-2026-114938/).

Microsoft announced the launch of Perception, which uses specialized AI agents to simulate attacks, investigate threats, and help fix vulnerabilities, joining an AI cybersecurity push alongside OpenAI and Anthropic as covered by Business Standard (https://www.business-standard.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/microsoft-perception-joins-ai-cybersecurity-push-by-openai-anthropic-more-126111800847_1.html).

Federal cybersecurity authorities issued alerts urging computer and smartphone users to keep devices updated due to actively exploited security vulnerabilities affecting Apple products and other platforms, as reported by Mega Doctor News (https://megadoctornews.com/cybersecurity-alert-as-hackers-exploit-computer-and-smartphone-vulnerabilities/).

recommendations: Prioritize patching CVE-2026-115731 (Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization Vulnerability, CVSS 9.4) added to CISA KEV on November 17, 2026.
Patch CVE-2026-40217 (BerriAI LiteLLM, CVSS 8.8) and CVE-2026-90436 (Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection) which were added to CISA KEV on November 18, 2026.
Review and update OpenJDK installations to mitigate potential risks associated with CVE-2026-114938.

Apply vendor updates for other newly listed CISA KEV entries including Synology DSM (CVE-2024-10441), Vanderbilt REDCap (CVE-2026-90817), UnrealIRCd (CVE-2026-114713), and Check Point products (CVE-2026-123039).
gaps: Detailed telemetry on internal network exposure to the listed CISA KEV vulnerabilities was not assessed.

args.query: top cybersecurity news vulnerabilities exploit November 2026
